## Problem
What problem does this feature solve?
(e.g. "Every time I start a new project I have to manually set up...")

## Proposed solution
How should it work?
A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Which repo does this affect?
- [ ] rn-template (base template or module)
- [ ] expo-kit (CLI tool)
- [ ] Both

## Is this a new module?
- [ ] Yes — new installable module
- [ ] No — improvement to existing feature

## Alternatives considered
Any other solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context
Any examples, references, or screenshots.
